captions.instagram:
Start here.

I'm Sarah, and I'm writing a memoir in real time about my father's murder and my mother's conviction. Narrative nonfiction, memoir fragments, and the ongoing investigation into my own life.

It's for readers who care more about the craft of the story than the true crime details.

Swipe through, then start reading at the link in bio.
